11. (a) Consider the collection A of natural numbers that do not contain a 9 in
their usual (base 10) representation. Show that the sum ofthe reciprocals
of the numbers in A converges. Hint: How many numbers between 1 and
9 are in A?; how many between 10 and 99?; etc.
(b) If B is the collection of natural numbers that do not have all 10 digits
0,..., 9 in their usual representation, then the sum of the reciprocals of
the numbers in B converges. (So “most” integers must have all ten digits
in their representation.)
